metadata.gitb:name: Building Energy Data Product Onboarding Suite - Priority Logic
metadata.gitb:description: DSSC / ITB onboarding test suite for building energy data products. The suite contains three test cases: metadata field validation, API response validation, and license policy validation.
metadata.gitb:documentation:
This suite uses the D SHACL profile for metadata field validation and applies one shared status mapping logic across all test cases.

Status priority: untestable > fail > inapplicable > pass.

Untestable means the input or validation environment prevents testing, for example malformed JSON-LD, parser failure, validator timeout, or infrastructure fault.

Fail means the input is testable but violates an in-scope rule, such as a missing required field, invalid enum value, non-HTTPS endpoint, temporal-order violation, API schema violation, or non-whitelisted license.

Inapplicable means there is no fail condition, but the SUT submitted data outside the declared rule scope, such as an undeclared metadata field or an API field not defined by the OpenAPI contract.

Pass means all in-scope required checks pass and no out-of-scope extra field is reported.

Before metadata SHACL validation, blank optional-field placeholders such as empty strings, whitespace-only strings, or tabs are normalized as absent.
